raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Upper-Body Rehab-Friendly Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Restore shoulder strength and upper-body capacity within pain-free range"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Pain-Free Motor Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Scapular control & horizontal pull":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated row 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          supine scapular retractions 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest-supported dumbbell row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing external rotation with band 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
    DAY Wednesday training 40m "Press alternatives & rotator cuff":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline chest-supported dumbbell press (low incline, <45°) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          neutral-grip seated dumbbell press (range within pain-free ROM, no overhead lockout) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          prone Y raises on incline bench (small ROM) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing internal rotation with band 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
    DAY Friday training 45m "Axial control & grip":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          supported single-arm landmine press (light load, pain-free range) 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          two-arm farmer carry (neutral grip) 3x2 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          horizontal band anti-rotation hold 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          wrist curls (dumbbell) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Scapular & horizontal strength":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          seated row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest-supported single-arm row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          band pull-apart (scapular retraction focus) 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          standing external rotation with band 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Controlled pressing & rotator work":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline chest-supported dumbbell press (low angle) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          neutral-grip landmine press (light, pain-free ROM) 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          prone T raises on incline bench 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          banded external rotation 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Grip & core stability":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          suitcase carry (neutral grip) 3x40s rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          horizontal row (TRX or rings, feet elevated if needed) 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press (band) 3x10 each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plate wrist rotations 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progress horizontal pulling":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest-supported row (heavier) 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single-arm seated row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          band face-pull (elbows high, external rotation) 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular clock exercises 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Controlled pressing progression":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          neutral-grip dumbbell press (partial overhead within pain-free range) 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline chest-supported dumbbell press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          prone Y raises 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Carry & stability":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          farmer carry (increase load) 3x60s rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          TRX horizontal row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          farmer carry single-arm anti-rotation hold 3x30s each rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          grip pinch holds 3x20s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Build load safely on horizontal plane":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bent-over chest-supported row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single-arm supported row heavy 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          band face-pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x20s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Low-risk press & rotator cuff":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          landmine press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline neutral-grip dumbbell press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          prone Y and T superset: prone Y raises 3x10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds then prone T raises 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band internal/external rotation superset: external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds then internal rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Conditioning & grip":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          loaded carry circuit: farmer carry 3x60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          TRX rows 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12 each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          wrist roller 3x2 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Strength & Capacity (progressive load)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Horizontal strength focus":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest-supported barbell row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          single-arm dumbbell row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          band face-pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular depression holds 3x20s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Press alternatives & rotator cuff":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          landmine press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          neutral-grip seated dumbbell press (limited ROM) 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          prone Y/T complex 3x10 each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Carries & pulling volume":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          heavy farmer carry 3x90s rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted row (feet elevated) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12 each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          grip holds 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive horizontal load":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest-supported row (heavier) 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          single-arm supported row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          band face-pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction isometrics 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Press variation & cuff":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          single-arm landmine press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline neutral-grip dumbbell press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          prone Y/T/W sequence 3x8 each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Volume carries & core":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          double suitcase carry 3x60s rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          TRX rows 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x15 each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          wrist roller 3x2 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength emphasis horizontal":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          supported barbell row 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          single-arm heavy dumbbell row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          band face-pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular hold with light band 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Press capacity (limited ROM)":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          neutral-grip seated dumbbell press (stop before pain) 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          landmine press heavy 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          prone Y/T/W 3x8 each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Endurance & grip":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          farmer carry ladder: 4 sets increasing time 4x30..90s rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted/TRX row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x15 each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          grip pinch holds 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Consolidation horizontal strength":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest-supported barbell row 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          single-arm row heavy 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          band face-pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular isometrics 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Press options & cuff maintenance":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          landmine press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline neutral-grip press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          prone Y/T/W 3x8 each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Carry conditioning & pulling":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          heavy farmer carry 3x90s rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          TRX/inverted row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12 each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          grip roller 3x2 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Return-to-Load & Specific Capacity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Horizontal max strength & scapula":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest-supported barbell row 5x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          single-arm heavy row 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          band face-pull 4x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x40s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Gradual overhead tolerance (pain-free only)":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          neutral-grip dumbbell press (partial to near-full ROM only if pain-free) 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          landmine press heavy 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          prone Y/T/W 3x8 each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Carry & climbing-specific prep":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          loaded farmer carry 4x90s rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          TRX rows 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hanging scapular depressions (pain-free, short) 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          grip holds / pinch 4x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength & scapular endurance":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest-supported barbell row 5x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          single-arm row 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          band face-pull 4x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular isometrics 3x40s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Overhead work only if pain-free":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          neutral-grip dumbbell press (only to pain-free ROM) 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          single-arm landmine press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          prone Y/T/W 3x8 each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Climbing prep & grip capacity":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          loaded carries 4x90s rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          TRX/inverted rows 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hangboard prep (short hangs, pain-free only) 4x5s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          grip pinch holds 4x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Max horizontal strength & durability":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest-supported barbell row 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          single-arm heavy row 4x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          band face-pull 4x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x45s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Final overhead check (only if pain-free)":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          neutral-grip seated dumbbell press (full ROM only if completely pain-free) 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          landmine press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          prone Y/T/W 3x8 each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Endurance & return-to-climb":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          loaded carries 4x90s rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          TRX rows 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hangboard and fingerboard (very low intensity, pain-free) 4x5s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          grip endurance circuit: pinch + wrist roller 3 rounds rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Consolidation & testing (no pain allowed)":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          chest-supported barbell row 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          single-arm row 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          band face-pull 4x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          scapular holds 3x45s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          doorway pec stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Return-to-overhead (conditional)":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          neutral-grip dumbbell press (only if pain-free through ROM) 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          landmine press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          prone Y/T/W 3x8 each rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band external rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          posterior capsule release 3m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Climb-ready conditioning":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          loaded carries 4x90s rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          TRX/inverted rows 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hangboard (short, pain-free) 4x5s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          grip circuit: pinch hold 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds then wrist roller 3x2 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobilization 3m
